en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a large four‑masted sailing ship moored along a riverfront or harbor promenade. Smaller boats are tied nearby. Behind the quay is a tree‑lined park and a low‑rise town with detached houses and a few institutional buildings. Several mid‑20th‑century cars are visible near the waterfront. The overall look suggests a historic tall ship preserved at a city waterfront. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.
